mapper.select: SELECT e.figure_type_id AS id, e.user_id, e.figure_type_group_id AS group_id, e.name, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM figure_type e LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.target_type = 'FIGURE_TYPE' AND t.target_id = e.figure_type_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.figure_type_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO figure_type (user_id, figure_type_group_id, name, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{figureTypeGroupId}, #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE figure_type SET name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_id = #{figureTypeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM figure_type WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND figure_type_id = #{figureTypeId}
